title: Bubble classification of immersions at the boundary of the moduli space with $8π$ Willmore energy
summary: We study the asymptotic bubbling behavior of sequences of weak genus-$p$ immersions with diverging conformal classes and limiting Willmore energy of $8π$. After applying suitable Möbius transformations, in a strong $W^{2,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}$-limit, we obtain two round spheres at the largest scale and $p+1$ catenoids at the smallest scales. Moreover, we apply this classification to sequences of isoperimetrically, conformally and normalized-total-mean-curvature constrained Willmore minimizers when the constraints approach the boundary of the domain where minimizers exist, respectively.
